AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE COMPILATION OF ORDINANCES OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT BY CREATING AN ORDINANCE TO BE ENTITLED “STANDARDS FOR OUTDOOR WATERING OF LANDSCAPE” FOR THE PURPOSE OF ADDRESSING THE ISSUE OF CONSERVING WATER BY SETTING STANDARDS FOR OUTDOOR WATERING; TO RESTRICT OUTDOOR WATERING; TO PROVIDE FOR EXEMPTIONS FOR OUTDOOR WATERING OTHER THAN THE TIMES SPECIFICALLY PROVIDED; TO PROVIDE FOR PENALITIES FOR VIOLATIONS OF THIS ORDINANCE AND ENFORCEMENT OF THE PROVISIONS OF THIS ORDINANCE; TO PROVIDE FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE FOR SAID ORDINANCE; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont recognizes an imminent need to create a culture of water conversation and to plan for water supply enhancement during future drought conditions and other water emergencies; and

WHEREAS, reasonable restrictions on the outdoor watering of landscape are necessary in the furtherance of addressing this need; and

WHEREAS, the General Assembly of the State of Georgia has required all municipalities in Georgia to adopt an ordinance to be in effect no later than January 1, 2011, to allow outdoor watering of landscape; and

WHEREAS, pursuant to O. C. G. A. § 12-5-7, the Town Council desires to create a new ordinance entitled “Standards for Outdoor Watering of Landscape” for the purpose of addressing the issue of conserving water by setting standards for outdoor watering; to restrict outdoor watering; to provide for exemptions for outdoor watering other than the times specifically provided; and to provide for the enforcement for violations of this ordinance.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, and it is hereby ordained by the authority of the same as follows:
5: “STANDARDS FOR OUTDOOR WATERING OF LANDSCAPE” is hereby ADOPTED as follows:
7: Outdoor watering for purposes of planting, growing, managing, or maintaining ground cover, trees, shrubs, or other plants in the incorporated area of the Town of Clermont, Georgia may occur only between the hours of 4:00 p.m. and 10:00 a.m., except as provided hereinafter.
9:
A. No person shall use or allow the use of water in violation of the restrictions on outdoor water use contained in this Chapter.

B. The Town law enforcement officers or other designated agent shall be the enforcement authority for this Chapter. The Mayor may also authorize other departments or agents as may be deemed necessary to support enforcement of this Chapter.
10: Any person, firm, corporation, association or partnership violating any provision of this ordinance as the same exists, or as it may hereinafter be amended, or shall fail to do anything required by this ordinance as the same exists or as it may hereinafter be amended, shall be guilty of a violation of this ordinance, amenable to the process of the municipal court or other court of proper jurisdiction, and upon conviction, shall be punished as provided up to the maximum fines or penalties allowed by the Charter for each violation in the discretion of the Court.
11: All Resolutions, or Ordinances, or parts thereof, in conflict with the terms of this ordinance are hereby repealed, but it is hereby provided that any resolution, ordinance or law, which may be applicable hereto and aid in carrying out and making effective the intent, purpose and provisions hereof, which shall be liberally construed to be in favor of the Town of Clermont, is hereby adopted as part hereof.
12:
If any paragraph, sub-paragraph, section, subsection, sentence, clause, phrase, or any portion of this ordinance shall be declared invalid or unconstitutional by any court of competent jurisdiction or if the provisions of any part of this ordinance as applied to any particular situation or set of circumstances shall be declared invalid or unconstitutional, such invalidity shall not be

construed to affect the portions of this ordinance not so held to be invalid. It is hereby declared to be the intent of the Clermont Town Council to provide for separable and divisible parts, and it does hereby adopt any and all parts hereof as may not be held invalid for any reason.
